# Third-party CI/CD marks

The vector marks in this directory support editorial identification in Figure 8 of the AWS Production Architecture article. They were downloaded on August 14, 2026 from the Simple Icons CDN, which packages recognizable project and product marks. Marks remain the property of their respective owners and are used at secondary scale without implying endorsement.

- GitHub and GitHub Actions: https://brand.github.com/foundations/logo
- Jenkins: https://www.jenkins.io/artwork/ (Jenkins project attribution; CC BY-SA 3.0)
- SonarQube Server: https://www.sonarsource.com/company/press/
- Snyk: https://snyk.io/
- Trivy: https://trivy.dev/
- Packaging source: https://simpleicons.org/
